{{Top|leg}}
A '''stentronic sensor pack''' was a compact, hand-held [[Sensor array/Legends|sensor array]]. The [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[K-3PO/Legends|K-3PO]] used a stentronic [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] pack to detect intruders while assigned to [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].
